name: Example T-slot nut for a 20-series profile
description: A drop-in T-slot nut for a 6 mm slot, with one or two tapped holes. An example generator: the code TN20-M4 is invented for this package and is not any maker's part number.
author: SolidCraft contributors
provenance: Representative dimensions for a generic slot-6 T-nut, drawn by hand for this example; the tap drills are the ISO coarse-thread tap drill sizes. Not a vendor drawing: check a real part before you rely on a size.

sources.title: ISO metric coarse thread tap drill sizes (public table)

grammar.refuse: {code} is not a TN20 ordering code. Use TN20-M3, M4, M5 or M6, optionally followed by -1 or -2 holes.
